pick.name: Anthropic Academy (Skilljar)
pick.what: Official courses: Claude Code 101/in Action, Building with the Claude API, Intro + Advanced MCP, agent skills, subagents, Cowork
pick.why: Exactly the stack you build on (Claude Code, MCP, skills, plugins), from the vendor, with completion certificates
pick.free_limits: Free (course pages show 'Register | FREE'); Skilljar account needed; completion certificates
pick.maintained: Catalogue current (23 courses incl. 'Introduction to subagents')

alts.name: Hugging Face Learn
alts.what: Free open courses: LLM, Agents, Context, smol course, Audio, Diffusion and more
alts.why: Best for open models, fine-tuning and agents beyond Claude

alts.name: DeepLearning.AI short courses
alts.what: 1-2 hour vendor-partnered courses (agents, MCP with Anthropic, evals, Claude Code)
alts.why: Fast, practical, many co-built with tool vendors
alts.free_limits: Short courses shown with 'Start' (price not on page)

candidates.name: fast.ai Practical Deep Learning
candidates.verdict: Free but 2022 recording; foundations only, needs Kaggle GPU

decision: Do Anthropic Academy first (Claude Code in Action, MCP Advanced, agent skills, subagents) because it maps 1:1 to what you ship. Use HF Learn for open models and DeepLearning.AI for one-off topics like evals.
